name: Text input
summary: A single-line field with a visible label, optional hint and an error message.

anatomy.purpose: Always visible above the field. Placeholder text is not a label.
The input box. Border needs 3:1 contrast against the background.
Short help below the label, such as the expected format.
Appears below the field with an icon and text. Says what is wrong and how to fix it.
Shown when there is a limit.

variants.name: With leading icon
variants.use: Search or currency fields where an icon adds meaning.

variants.name: Multi-line
variants.use: Comments or messages over one line.

contentLimits.label: max 40 characters
contentLimits.count: show a character count above 200 characters

whenToUse: Collecting short free text: name, email, search.
whenNotToUse: A small fixed set of options: use radios, select or a segmented control.
Dates or numbers with strict format: use a specialized input.

keyboard: Enter submits the form from a single-line input.
accessibility.focus: Show a 2px focus ring. Do not hide it on click.
notes: Link hint and error with aria-describedby; set aria-invalid=true on error.
Error text must have 4.5:1 contrast and include an icon or the word Error, not just red color.
Use the right type and autocomplete values (email, tel, one-time-code).
Mobile text size must be 16px or larger to stop iOS from zooming.
